messages:
anna: Quick sync — Orion SI onboarding checklist for marketplace + hw vouchers. Need to finalize training cadence and cert badge before next Tuesday. Marketplace listing requires partner ID, security attestation, and one integration doc. Who can own the HW voucher flow?
sam: I can take the voucher flow. Do we have a voucher redemption API? @devon?
devon: There's a simple endpoint: POST /partner/vouchers/redeem with body { code, email }. I'll make a small Postman example and share. ETA EOD.
marta: I'll own the training. Plan: 3 live workshops (intro, deployment, ops) + self-study labs. Proposed dates: Apr 5, Apr 12, Apr 19. Need lab instances: 2x A10G for hands-on. @kevin can we reserve?
kevin: Reserved 2x A10G for those dates in the partners pool. Also adding 10 sandbox GPUs for on-demand testing. Need list of partner accounts + emails to provision.
anna: Great. Sam — voucher workflow + redemption link goes into partners docs. Also need marketplace listing copy + screenshots. I'll draft copy, need a quick tech screenshot of a model routing table.
devon: I'll export a snippet. Use this sample CLI to spin a test model: ```
rwdctl deploy --model rwd/llama-2 --region eu-west --instance g4dn.xlarge
```
marta: Certification proposal: two levels — "Integrator" and "Architect". Exam: 30 questions, 60 minutes, proctored. Badge icons: bronze / silver. Ops question — anyone have preferred telemetry wording for cert verification?
sam: Legal confirmed minimal telemetry is ok: partner_id, pass/fail, timestamp. No PII. I'll loop in legal for final wording.
anna: Can we produce both a public-facing partner playbook PDF and a private internal onboarding runbook? Need both by next Friday for the launch checklist.
kevin: I'll set up a Notion workspace and export the playbook PDF. Draft Notion page by Wednesday, PDF by Friday.
marta: For labs, I'll author 5 checkpoints: deploy -> route -> stress test -> failover -> cost analysis. Each checkpoint will have automated tests.
devon: Add quick troubleshooting notes: common failure is missing KMS keys or incorrect CORS on the dashboard. Add snippet in infra playbook: `aws kms:create-alias --target-key-id <key-id> --alias-name alias/redwood-partner`
anna: Action items summary: Sam -> voucher flow (owner), Marta -> training + cert content, Kevin -> infra reservations + Notion playbook, Devon -> CLI snippet + troubleshooting doc. I'll schedule a 30m sync Thu 9am PT and send calendar invite.
sam: 👍
kevin: On it :calendar:
marta: thanks all :rock_on:
